title: Le chien sans maison : texte à trous

review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the French and the answers before using it with learners.
intro: The words come from the text, used in new sentences. Accents are not required to be marked right.

items.tr: I buy bread at the bakery.
Wash your hands: they are dirty!
The sea is very calm today.
The little boy follows his mum around the shop.
We eat in the garden when the weather is nice.
He asks a police officer for directions.
The baby is sleeping in his room.
